capabilities: Mask note and folder names with eye buttons in the file explorer
Mask note content with stars while keeping word lengths and line breaks
Reveal or mask everything with a global ribbon toggle
Exclude masked notes from search, quick switcher, and graph labels
Sync masks across devices via a masked property and hidden .masked files
disambiguation: A visual privacy screen, not encryption: files stay in plain text on disk.
extras: Folder masks use hidden .masked files, so sync tools that skip hidden files (such as Obsidian Sync) won't carry them; hiding from search, quick switcher, and graph labels relies on Obsidian internals and may break after updates. Masked notes cannot be edited until revealed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually hide sensitive notes and folders when sharing a screen or device.
summary: Privacy screen that masks note and folder names and contents with stars, with a global eye button to reveal or hide everything at once.
